purpose: Emphasize that something has never happened in one’s experience.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
He has never once been on time.
This method has never failed me.
I have never had a bad experience at that shop.
restrictions: Often expresses a strong judgment about a repeated pattern.
mistake: It describes past experience, not a logical impossibility.
